declarations.name: AuiAvatar

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Accessible name and source of the initials.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Image URL: http(s), relative, blob:, or a base64 PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF data URL.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Icon shown when the name yields no initials.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Presence dot; its name is part of the accessible name.

inputs.name: decorative
inputs.description: Hide from assistive technology when the name is shown next to it.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of status names and initials casing.

accessibility.pattern: Image with a text alternative: role=img on the host, aria-label with the name and presence status.

limitations: A failed image is not retried until src changes.
Initials use the first and last word of the name; names written family-name-first show those initials in that order.
